data.text:
Reena Sharma vs State Of Up And 3 Others on 23 July, 2024 
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad 
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:117414
Court No. - 5 
Case :- Writ - A No. - 10512 of 2024
Petitioner :- Reena Sharma 
Respondent :- State of U.P. and others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Deepak Maurya 
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble J.J. Munir,J.
1. Heard learned Counsel for the petitioner and learned Standing Counsel appearing on behalf of the
State. 
2.  By the impugned order, the petitioner, who is a Food Safety Officer, has been transferred from Meerut to Agra. The petitioner assails the transfer order dated 30.06.2024 and submits that she is in the family way and it would imperil her life if she is forced to join at Agra, the station where she has been transferred to. 
3. On instructions, the learned Standing Counsel submits that the respondents' stand is that the petitioner has been posted at Meerut for more than 8 years, and in the event she is in the family way, which makes her difficult to move station, she can apply for maternity leave. 
4. Learned Counsel for the petitioner points out that for the purpose of applying for maturity leave,
the petitioner would have to travel from Meerut to Agra and join duties there and then alone can she apply for maternity leave. He submits that presently, the petitioner's health does not permit that Reena Sharma vs State Of Up And 3 Others on 23 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/165345549/
1 movement without imperiling her life.
5. Be that as it may, the petitioner has submitted a representation to the Principal Secretary, Food and Civil Supplies, Government of U.P., Lucknow dated 02.07.2024. 
6. The Principal Secretary, Food and Civil Supplies, Government of U.P., Lucknow is ordered to decide the petitioner's representation dated 02.07.2024 in accordance with the State's transfer policy within a period of one week of the receipt of this order and communicate the order that he makes on the representation within three days of recording it. 
7. The writ petition stands disposed of in terms of the orders aforesaid. 
8. The Registrar (Compliance) is directed to communicate this order to the Principal Secretary, Food and Civil Supplies, Government of U.P., Lucknow through the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Lucknow within 48 hours next. 
Order Date :- 23.7.2024 I. Batabyal (J.J. Munir, J.)
